description: This file defines the LDAPSyncStatusDecorator class, a decorator for the LDAPSyncStatus entity that provides formatted accessors for synchronization timestamps and associates LDAP sync status with a user. It utilizes traits for ORM helpers and date-time formatting and interacts with external entity classes like User.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for LDAPSyncStatus entity that adds methods to set and retrieve formatted sync timestamps and associate the sync status with a user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an LDAPSyncStatus entity.

methods.name: setSyncedUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a user with the LDAPSyncStatus using a user ID.

methods.name: getSyncStartedDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the synchronization in a formatted string.

methods.name: getSyncStartedTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the synchronization in a formatted string.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedDate
methods.description: Returns the finish date of the synchronization in a formatted string.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedTime
methods.description: Returns the finish time of the synchronization in a formatted string.
